# Greenyer, "The Power and Signature of the Topological Monopole" (TeslaTech 2026)

**Source:** Bob W. Greenyer (Martin Fleischmann Memorial Project), conference talk, TeslaTech,
15 August 2026, 1 h 42 min: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y1jlQ3dor4E>. The full transcript
was supplied by the user and used for the review; it is the talk's own text, so it is not kept in
this repository.

**The user's request:** a deep dive on everything mentioned (the real science), investigated and
implemented across the stack, with real calculations; the topological monopole and magnetic
charges especially. "We want to prove all of these with mathematics."

**As supplied (the video's description):**

> Bob W. Greenyer argues that fractal magneto-hydrodynamic structures produce topological
> monopoles, phase singularities that can transmute matter, emit coherent matter waves and enable
> new energy and propulsion technologies.
> The Power and Signature of the Topological Monopole
> Bob W. Greenyer, conference talk, TeslaTech 2026, 15 August 2026
> Greenyer presents the theory and experimental signatures of the topological monopole, from
> Dirac's 1931 proposal to the Wheel within Wheel within Wheel (WwWwW) structure and the Fractal
> Toroidal Moment (FTM). He links these to iron-rich crenellated microspheres, Strange Radiation
> tracks, ball lightning, the Hutchison effect, Ohmasa Gas, LION and VEGA reactor samples, and
> oxygen as a fuel. The talk ends with a live demo of his ARV flight simulator and an extended Q&A
> on building the real craft and transmutation.
